name: Remove metadata template

context:

context:

name: List metadata template's options for taxonomy field
description: List metadata template's options for taxonomy field Used to retrieve metadata taxonomy nodes which are available for the taxonomy field based on its configuration and the parameters specified. GET /2.0/metadata_templates/{namespace}/{template_key}/fields/{field_key}/options
context:
GET /2.0/metadata_templates/{namespace}/{template_key}/fields/{field_key}/options
Used to retrieve metadata taxonomy nodes which are available for the taxonomy field based on its configuration and the parameters specified. Results are sorted in lexicographic order unless a `query` parameter is passed. With a `query` parameter specified, results are sorted in order of relevance.
Required: namespace (path) — The namespace of the metadata taxonomy.; template_key (path) — The name of the metadata template.; field_key (path) — The key of the metadata taxonomy field in the template.
Optional: level (query) — Filters results by taxonomy level. Multiple values can be provided. Results include nodes that match any of the specified values.; parent (query) — Node identifier of a direct parent node. Multiple values can be provided. Results include nodes that match any of the specified values.; ancestor (query) — Node identifier of any ancestor node. Multiple values can be provided. Results include nodes that match any of the specified values.; query (query) — Query text to search for the taxonomy nodes.; include-total-result-count (query) — When set to `true` this provides the total number of nodes that matched the query. The response will compute counts of up to 10,000 elements. Defaults to `false`.; only-selectable-options (query) — When set to `true`, this only returns valid selectable options for this template taxonomy field. Otherwise, it returns all taxonomy nodes, whether or not they are selectable. Defaults to `true`.; marker (query) — Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is used when paginating using marker-based pagination. This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return per page.

name: Update metadata template
description: Update metadata template Updates a metadata template. PUT /2.0/metadata_templates/{scope}/{template_key}/schema
context:
PUT /2.0/metadata_templates/{scope}/{template_key}/schema
Updates a metadata template. The metadata template can only be updated if the template already exists. The update is applied atomically. If any errors occur during the application of the operations, the metadata template will not be changed.
Required: scope (path) — The scope of the metadata template.; template_key (path) — The name of the metadata template.
Optional: body (body)
